text:
tess: Heads-up: planning a staggered cohort lift for feature-flag `routing.split_lift` in a short night window (Mon 2026-05-03 00:30-02:00 UTC). Need a compact ramp + circuit-breaker pin rules.
omar: Proposal: 0.5% (5m) -> 4% (10m) -> 18% (20m). Hold after each step for telemetry snapshot.
vikram: Circuit-breaker rules: if errors (5xx + infer-fail) > 0.8% OR p95 > 360ms for 2 consecutive 5m buckets, trigger pin for affected cohorts and open incident.
tess: Also include a snapshot rollback: capture routing state & sample traces at each holdpoint so we can revert deterministically.
oncall-ops: I'll be oncall. Set alerts to 2 consecutive 5m buckets. If auto-pin fails, I'll run manual circuit-breaker and post status.
deploy-bot: Scheduling: 2026-05-03T00:30Z/2026-05-03T02:00Z. Rollout configured with cohorts, circuit-breaker pin on breach, manual resume required after >25m pause.
omar: Add fallback rule: on pin, route impacted traffic to `quantized-fallback-v1` for stability while triage runs.
vikram: Telemetry tag: `rollout=splitlift-0503`. Log cohort_id and shard for any pin action.
tess: Runbook snippet: 
```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \ 
  --window "2026-05-03T00:30Z/2026-05-03T02:00Z" \ 
  --ff routing.split_lift --ramp "0.5:5m,4:10m,18:20m" \ 
  --circuit-breaker "errors>0.8% OR p95>360ms" --hold-agg "2x5m" \ 
  --on-breach pin=previous --fallback quantized-fallback-v1 \ 
  --meta rollout_tag=splitlift-0503
```
oncall-ops: I'll attach alert screenshots and the snapshot script before EOD.
tess: Approvals?
omar: Approved.
vikram: Approved.
oncall-ops: Approved, I'll be available.
deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and notifications scheduled to post in #eng-releases and #eng-sre at T-30m and start.
